tools.transport: POST {baseUrl}/mcp — JSON-RPC 2.0 `tools/call` {name, arguments}, `authorization: Bearer {apiKey}`; the result's text content is JSON. `call(tool, args)` reaches ANY platform tool by name.

root.name: whoami
root.doc: The account this key belongs to.

root.name: search
root.doc: Search the whole tool catalog by keyword.

root.name: run
root.doc: Run a snippet server-side (JavaScript / TypeScript / Python).

root.name: post
root.doc: Publish a file to a connected social account.

namespaces.name: threads
namespaces.doc: Agent threads — the unit of work.

methods.name: list
methods.doc: Your threads.

methods.name: get
methods.doc: One thread's detail.

methods.name: create
methods.doc: Spawn a thread: {intent, snapshotId?, …}, or {agentless: true, snapshotId} for a world you drive.

methods.name: send
methods.doc: Message a thread.

methods.name: events
methods.doc: A thread's event log.

methods.name: kill
methods.doc: Stop a thread's run (the thread itself persists).

namespaces.name: embodiments
namespaces.doc: Computers, cameras, robots and sims attached to a thread.

methods.name: list
methods.doc: Attached embodiments.

methods.name: launch
methods.doc: Launch an embodiment into the thread: {kind?, snapshotId?, fromSnapshotId?}.

methods.name: observe
methods.doc: The thread's observation plane: stream channels and the latest frame per embodiment.

methods.name: controls
methods.doc: What an embodiment can be driven with right now: channels, actions, payload schemas.

methods.name: act
methods.doc: Drive an embodiment with one declared action (see controls).

methods.name: describe
methods.doc: The live sim/robot world: robots, objects and poses the runtime reports.

namespaces.name: billing
namespaces.doc: Resold third-party services, charged at the provider's price (docs/billing.md).

methods.name: prices
methods.doc: Every pass-through price, with its source and date.

methods.name: quote
methods.doc: What a service costs before you buy it: {price: "twilio/us-sms", months?, units?, oneTime?}.

methods.name: charges
methods.doc: The account's pass-through line items, monthly items and balance.

namespaces.name: memory
namespaces.doc: The agent's durable memory: markdown files under memories/ in the thread's drive.

methods.name: search
methods.doc: Recall by query (the drive's content index over memories/).

methods.name: remember
methods.doc: Write a memory file.

methods.name: forget
methods.doc: Delete a memory file by its path.

methods.name: list
methods.doc: What's connected.

methods.name: call
methods.doc: Drive a provider's API (method/path/query/body).

namespaces.name: web
namespaces.doc: Web search through many providers, one shape (docs/search.md): each result names who returned it; each call says what it cost.

methods.name: search
methods.doc: Search: kind search | news | academic | code | social | images | video; provider, limit, since, domains … in opts.

methods.name: fetch
methods.doc: One page as clean text.

methods.name: crawl
methods.doc: Many pages of one site (pages in opts).

methods.name: answer
methods.doc: An answer with citations; depth research for a long report.

methods.name: providers
methods.doc: The providers: what each offers and costs, and whether you can call it.

namespaces.name: postal
namespaces.doc: Paper mail (docs/postal.md): letters from a .letter.tsx and postcards from a .postcard.tsx in your files, and mailboxes that receive and scan mail.

methods.name: quote
methods.doc: What mailing the letter or postcard would cost, and how it would go. Costs nothing.

methods.name: send
methods.doc: Mail the letter or postcard: charged first, recorded before it is sent, never retried. An agent needs a postal grant.

methods.name: status
methods.doc: A sent piece's state and records; without a piece, the sent pieces.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Cancel a piece before it is printed; the charge comes back.

methods.name: inbox
methods.doc: Your mailboxes, or one mailbox's received pieces with their scans.

namespaces.name: social
namespaces.doc: A single connected social account, bound: cagi.social('tiktok', '@brand').post(fileId).

methods.name: post
methods.doc: Publish a stored file to this account.

methods.name: call
methods.doc: Raw API call as this account.

namespaces.name: phone
namespaces.doc: The account's phone lines (docs/phone.md). An agent texts and calls only under a phone grant its owner made.

methods.name: lines
methods.doc: The lines you own or may use.

methods.name: conversations
methods.doc: A line's conversations, newest first.

methods.name: read
methods.doc: One conversation's records (phone/<line>/<correspondent>.jsonl); `after` is a record id or an ISO time.

methods.name: quote
methods.doc: What buying a number charges now, monthly and per use. Buys nothing.

methods.name: text
methods.doc: Send a text (an MMS with drive-file media). Recorded before it is sent; never retried.

methods.name: call
methods.doc: Click-to-call: ring the line's forward-to number (or a number your grant lists), then connect to `to`.

namespaces.name: vpn
namespaces.doc: The VPN overlay (docs/vpn.md): its nodes and exits, and egress from an exit's address.

methods.name: status
methods.doc: The account's nodes, the exits it may use, the ACL and the exit grants.

methods.name: fetch
methods.doc: Fetch a URL from a VPN exit's address (method, headers, body, exit in opts); refused without an exit grant.

session.transport: Frames: WebSocket {baseUrl→ws}/rt/thread/{threadId}?token={apiKey}; server messages `frame` {embodimentId, channelId, url} carry the latest image (a data: URL or an https URL fetched with the same bearer). Control: every vocabulary method is `embodiments.act(embodimentId, action, payload)` — the thread resolves the action against what that embodiment live-declares (embodiments.controls).
